CustomField.description: Was this finding correct? Deliberately separate from Status__c, which answers whether anyone will act on it. A finding can be right and not worth fixing (Status Suppressed), and it can be wrong (Verdict False Positive) — folding those into one field is why no rule has ever had a measured precision. Only this field moves a rule up the maturity ladder.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Was the finding itself correct? Not whether you plan to fix it.
CustomField.label: Verdict
